description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) VIGIL UNENDING (Lions of the Emperor, 2 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the Orks' Shooting phase); the Nobz are moved within range of the Allarus Custodians (TERMINATOR), which are moved forward. The Ork player targets the Allarus with the Nobz: the Custodes' reactive StratagemDialog offers VIGIL UNENDING (folded into the legacy reactive list); a real click spends 2 CP: attacks that target the Allarus have -1 Damage until the Nobz have attacked — after the shooting resolves the effect is gone.
